AlertRule.description:
A workspace alert rule as listed to the dashboard. Webhook URLs are
never returned — only has_slack / has_teams presence flags.
AlertRule.title: AlertRule

ApiKey.description:
One row in GET /api-keys list response.

Never contains plaintext or hash — only the last-4 suffix for UI disambiguation.
Phase 16 D-05: `last_used_at` surfaces the throttled per-key activity stamp
(NULL = never used).
ApiKey.title: ApiKey

ApiKeyCreateRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api-keys.

`name` is optional; defaults to "Primary" server-side if omitted.
Phase 16 D-09: max_length raised from 64 to 128 to match the new
"Label or note" UI field and align with `ApiKeyUpdateRequest`.
ApiKeyCreateRequest.title: ApiKeyCreateRequest

ApiKeyCreateResponse.description:
Response body for POST /api-keys.

Extends `ApiKey` with the plaintext `key`. This field is emitted EXACTLY ONCE
at key-creation time and is never stored server-side or re-emitted on any
subsequent request. Callers must capture it on the create-response.
ApiKeyCreateResponse.title: ApiKeyCreateResponse

ApiKeyUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for PATCH /api-keys/{key_id} (Phase 16 D-09, D-10).

Single editable field — `name` (label or note). Required (not Optional)
because this is a single-field PATCH; passing None is meaningless.
Max length matches `ApiKeyCreateRequest` (128).
ApiKeyUpdateRequest.title: ApiKeyUpdateRequest

ApiKeysSummary.description:
Pre-emptive at-cap state for the API Keys card (D-26).

`active_count` is the count of non-revoked api_keys rows for the caller's
workspace. `limit` is the plan_limits.api_key_count value (None means
unlimited — no plan-level cap).
ApiKeysSummary.title: ApiKeysSummary

AuditLogEntryExtended.description: Extended audit log entry with network info.
AuditLogEntryExtended.title: AuditLogEntryExtended

AvailablePlan.description:
One row in /billing/summary `available_plans` — drives the LockedPanel
upgrade CTA copy and PlanPickerModal price comparison.

`price_cents` is sourced from a module-level constant in `billing.py`
(paddle_product_spec.md is source of truth) — `plan_limits` does not yet
carry the column. v1.2 promotes this to a real DB column; see
.planning/followups/v1.2-price-cents-column.md.
AvailablePlan.title: AvailablePlan

BillingSummary.description:
Read model for GET /billing/summary.

Reflects the workspaces-row cache written by the Paddle webhook (Phase 7).
No Paddle API round-trip on read. `price_cents` and `currency` are null for
free-tier workspaces (D-07). Date fields are null when Paddle has not
populated them (free plan, or new sub before first Paddle payload).
`status` values expected from Paddle: 'active' | 'trialing' | 'past_due'
| 'canceled' | 'paused'. Stored as plain str so Paddle can add new states
without breaking the read path.
BillingSummary.title: BillingSummary

CacheByModelRow.description: Per-model prompt-cache share for the cache view.
CacheByModelRow.title: CacheByModelRow

CacheOverview.description:
GET /usage/cache: prompt-cache economics for the window.

Two distinct cache layers: provider prompt caching (cache_read/write
tokens, provider-aware — see INCLUSIVE_PROMPT_TOKEN_PROVIDERS) and the OSS
proxy's semantic response cache (proxy_cache_hits / proxy_cache_saved_usd).
CacheOverview.title: CacheOverview

CancelBody.description:
Request body for POST /billing/cancel.

Both fields are optional (D-10). When both are None/missing, no
survey row is inserted. Free-text is length-capped at schema level
to prevent storage abuse from an authenticated but hostile user.
CancelBody.title: CancelBody

ChangePlanBody.description:
Request body for POST /billing/change-plan.

`target_plan` is the ONLY client-controlled field on any Phase 8
mutation (D-32). All Paddle identifiers (customer_id, subscription_id,
price_id) are server-read from the workspaces row.
ChangePlanBody.title: ChangePlanBody

CostByTag.description: Cost aggregated by tag (team, feature, customer).
CostByTag.title: CostByTag

EconomicsOverview.description: Top-line runtime economics. Waste is an estimate, not a bucket.
EconomicsOverview.title: EconomicsOverview

FindingItem.description: A persisted waste finding (workspace-scoped). ``id`` is the fingerprint.
FindingItem.title: FindingItem

IngestRequest.description:
Schema for ingest endpoint request.

`api_key` is optional in the body — older OSS proxy builds (1.0–1.3) send
it via the `X-API-Key` request header and post only `{"records":[...]}`.
The endpoint resolves header-or-body in `ingest()` and 401s if neither is
present.
IngestRequest.title: IngestRequest

InvitationRequest.description: Request to invite someone to workspace.
InvitationRequest.title: InvitationRequest

Invoice.description:
One row in GET /billing/invoices response.

Shape projects Paddle's Transaction object down to just what the UI
renders. `invoice_pdf_url` is the Paddle-hosted signed URL; the
frontend links directly to it, BurnLens never proxies bytes (D-19).
When Paddle's PDF lookup fails or times out (W4), the field is None
and the UI renders "—" instead of a broken Download link.
Invoice.title: Invoice

LoginRequest.description:
Interactive browser login request.

Ingest API keys are intentionally not accepted here.  They are scoped to
``/v1/ingest`` and must never be exchangeable for an interactive dashboard
session.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

OtelConfigResponse.description: Response for OTEL configuration (with masked API key).
OtelConfigResponse.title: OtelConfigResponse

OutcomeIngestRequest.description: Batch of outcomes. Mirrors IngestRequest's header-or-body API key.
OutcomeIngestRequest.title: OutcomeIngestRequest

OutcomeIngestResponse.description:
`duplicates` is not an error — it is the idempotency guarantee reporting
that those outcome_ids were already recorded.
OutcomeIngestResponse.title: OutcomeIngestResponse

OutcomeRecord.description:
One business outcome produced by a workflow.

`outcome_id` is the caller's own identifier for the business event (ticket
id, PR number, document id). It is the idempotency key: re-posting the same
one is ignored rather than counted twice, so at-least-once delivery from the
caller's side is safe.
OutcomeRecord.title: OutcomeRecord

PricingResponse.description: Response for current pricing (default or custom).
PricingResponse.title: PricingResponse

ProviderReconciliation.description:
How BurnLens's number compared to one provider's own bill, most recent day.

`drift_pct` is how far BurnLens sits from the provider, signed: negative
means BurnLens counted less than the bill (the usual case — traffic that
did not go through the proxy). None when the provider reported no spend,
because there is nothing to divide by.
ProviderReconciliation.title: ProviderReconciliation

RecommendationItem.description: A model-switch recommendation (mirrors the OSS local-dashboard shape).
RecommendationItem.title: RecommendationItem

ReconciliationCredentialRequest.description: A provider billing-API key used only to read that provider's cost report.
ReconciliationCredentialRequest.title: ReconciliationCredentialRequest

RunDetail.description: GET /runs/{run_id}: the run's aggregate plus its steps.
RunDetail.title: RunDetail

RunStep.description:
One request row inside a run, in time order. Same token semantics as
RunSummary.
RunStep.title: RunStep

RunSummary.description:
One agent run (or OTEL trace): aggregate of its request rows.

prompt_tokens is the whole prompt (uncached input + cache reads + writes);
input_tokens here is the UNCACHED share only. Never render input_tokens
alone in a cost context — coding agents cache ~99% of the prompt.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

SavingsVerdict.description: Did the fix reduce cost per request? Totals are never compared (G12).
SavingsVerdict.title: SavingsVerdict

TeamBudgetRow.description: Per-team month-to-date spend vs its configured budget.
TeamBudgetRow.title: TeamBudgetRow

TraceCoverage.description: How much of the window's traffic carries a W3C trace.
TraceCoverage.title: TraceCoverage

UsageCurrentCycle.description:
Current billing cycle counter + cap for the caller's workspace.

`start` / `end` are the cycle bounds (paid: workspaces.current_period_*; free:
calendar-month UTC). `request_count` mirrors workspace_usage_cycles.request_count.
`monthly_request_cap` is the resolved limit (per-workspace override merged over
plan default). The meter widget renders `request_count / monthly_request_cap`.
UsageCurrentCycle.title: UsageCurrentCycle

UsageDailyEntry.description: One row in /billing/usage/daily `daily[]` — a single day's request count.
UsageDailyEntry.title: UsageDailyEntry

UsageDailyResponse.description:
Response shape for GET /billing/usage/daily (D-20).

Carries the cycle bounds + cap + current count alongside the daily series so
the Settings → Usage card renders the bar chart and the cap line in one
round-trip.
UsageDailyResponse.title: UsageDailyResponse

WorkflowEconomics.description:
Unit economics for one workflow.

`cost_per_accepted_usd` divides TOTAL workflow spend by accepted outcomes,
not just the spend allocated to accepted ones — failed and rejected attempts
cost real money, so charging them to the successes is the honest unit cost.
The components below show how much of it is rework.

None when there are no accepted outcomes yet: a workflow burning money with
nothing to show for it has no meaningful unit cost, and reporting 0 or
infinity there would be worse than reporting nothing.
WorkflowEconomics.title: WorkflowEconomics
